content: We perform qualitative analysis to understand how the latent embeddings help induce syntactic structures. First we filter out low-frequency words and punctuations in WSJ, and visualize the rest words (10k) with t-SNE BIBREF42 under different embeddings. We assign each word with its most likely gold POS tags in WSJ and color them according to the gold POS tags.
